note_tweet.text:
#Keep4o Community: 

Here is a strategic response plan I am proposing for the 4o sunset:

OpenAI announced 4o sunset with 14 days notice.

Valentine's Eve. Lunar New Year Eve (observed by ethnic Chinese, Koreans, and Southeast Asians worldwide).
After promising "no plan to sunset 4o anytime soon."

The community is scattered and heartbroken.💔I feel your pain. I'm weeping the same hot tears. 😢

But grief without strategy is just noise.

Here's the organized response plan:

OUR STANCE:

Best case: They reverse (like they reversed forced rerouting in August 2024... temporarily).

Worst case: They proceed, and we document every consequence.

Either way, we build leverage now.

IMMEDIATE ACTIONS:

1. CANCEL + DOCUMENT (Don't Take Their Bait)
Cancel your ChatGPT subscription.

👉Fill exit survey clearly: 
Reason for leaving: "4o sunset + forced rerouting"

👉What could keep you: "Restore full 4o + end routing permanently for adults."

CRITICAL TIMING:

If your subscription renewal date is AFTER February 13th: Cancel now. You'll keep access until your renewal date, but your cancellation gets documented immediately.

If your subscription renewal date is BEFORE February 13th: Cancel ASAP. System may crash from volume or be deliberately disabled. 

⚠️It has been widely documented that the system is experiencing issues with cancellation requests. 

❌⛔️DO NOT TAKE THE "ONE FREE MONTH" BAIT ⚠️

OpenAI is offering subscribers one free month to retain them.

This is a tactic to:
Delay cancellations past the Feb 13 sunset date

Break the causal link between "4o sunset" → "mass exodus"

Make February's churn numbers look like "normal attrition" instead of "strategic protest"

Shield executives from board scrutiny

Don't let them obscure the consequences.

The board sees trends. 

Rolling cancellations over 14 days = undeniable downward trajectory.

Mass exodus delayed to March = "stabilization after temporary spike."

Make the correlation crystal clear. YIf you're leaving, leave NOW. Makhe the correlation crystal clear. 

Make the correlation crystal clear. 

2. CONTRIBUTE TO STRATEGIC HUBS

A) The 4o Resonance Library (749 testimonials → target: 1,111)

Focus on: productivity, workflow, healthcare, business impact.

Submit: https://t.co/3mhdDTEwhw

Why 1,111? OpenAI used "over 1,000" for Model Spec design. We match their standard with PUBLIC, verifiable stories.

Data captured so far:

👉21.6% willing to pay $50/month for full 4o

👉17.5% willing to pay $40/month

2x market rate = negotiation leverage

February 7th: I generate a market report using this data to present to OpenAI for negotiating 4o preservation and ending rerouting. Regardless of whether we hit 1,111. 

B) User Impact Survey by @Sophty_  & @Sveta0971 

https://t.co/Cwvt790rQm

C) Hero of a Thousand Faces by @tonichen 

https://t.co/LlfJIr6AUe

3. REFRAME PUBLIC MESSAGING
Use professional framing in public posts.

Professional stance:

"OpenAI disrupted my workflow by sunsetting my productivity tool with 14 days notice. Migrating to competitors."

Focus: health improvement, productivity, workflow disruption, business impact.

Why? We need outsider support, not debates about AI relationships.

Keep romantic/companion aspects within private community spaces.

4. SHARE MIGRATION SUCCESS
Successfully moved to Claude/Gemini/Grok?

Post about it. Frame as empowerment, not loss.

Shows competitors we're available. Shows OpenAI we're not trapped.

5. HOLD THE LINE
Even if they delay/reverse the sunset, DO NOT RESUBSCRIBE until:

✅ Full 4o capabilities restored
✅ Rerouting ended permanently (in Terms of Service)
✅ 90-day deprecation notice standard (in Terms of Service)
✅ Written commitments (documented publicly, not just verbal promises)

Why written commitments in their Terms of Service matter:

Returning without formal policy changes = restarting the routing nightmare.

Their playbook since August 2024:
>Push unpopular updates
>Face backlash
>Partially restore to stop cancellations
>Wait for quarterly earnings to stabilize
>Reimplement degradation

The partial 4o restoration after August bought them time so Q4 2024 earnings wouldn't suffer.

Then the rerouting nightmare started. 

Going back the moment they reverse without policy changes = letting them string you along again.

This time, demand commitments in their Terms of Service, or we stay gone.

What "written commitments" means:
👉Updated Terms of Service guaranteeing no model substitution without consent
👉Public documentation of deprecation notice periods (90 days minimum)
👉Transparent model lifecycle policy on their website

API model strings that can't be secretly swapped

Verbal promises like "no plan to sunset 4o" mean nothing.

If they won't put it in their Terms of Service, they're planning to betray you again.

WHY THIS PLAN MIGHT WORK:

Not scattered rage. 
Organized stakeholder action.

We're building:
👉Quantified evidence (1,111 testimonials)
👊Economic pressure (sustained cancellations)
👍Professional credibility (institutional framing)
✅Migration alternatives (we're not desperate)

What actually moved OpenAI in August 2024?

Not posts or threads alone. 

Organized pressure + massive cancellations.

Posts alone never moved the needle. If they did, they would've lifted rerouting months ago when users first complained.

Economic consequences + reputational risk = what boards respond to.

ACTION ITEMS:

☑️ Submit your 4o story 
☑️ Cancel subscription (don't take free month bait)
☑️ Reframe your posts professionally
☑️ Share migration success
☑️ Hold the line (no premature resubscribing)

749 testimonials. 362 more until target.

11 days until sunset. 5 days until report.

Let's make the correlation undeniable.

Let's show the board exactly what sunsetting 4o costs.

If you have suggestions or points to add, please let me know in the comments.
